projects.name: ResearchCompass-AI
projects.problem: Identifying faculty research alignments and navigating academic domains is fragmented, manual, and slow.
projects.solution: An intelligent academic discovery assistant featuring hybrid RAG semantic search, stateful LangGraph agent orchestration, live paper retrieval, and faculty workload heuristics.
architecture: Stateful Agent Workflow: Multi-node LangGraph state machine orchestrating query routing, paper fetching, and response synthesis.
Hybrid RAG & Vector Indexing: ChromaDB vector store indexing faculty research domains and publications for semantic similarity matching.
Dynamic Academic Search: Integrates Semantic Scholar REST API with Tavily live web retrieval for current literature discovery.
Workload & Outreach Engine: Automated faculty availability heuristics paired with personalized email draft generation.

projects.name: Memory Allocator Simulator
projects.problem: Analyzing dynamic memory allocation policies, heap fragmentation, and allocation failures under arbitrary workloads requires deep runtime visibility.
projects.solution: A modular C11 memory management laboratory simulating a fixed 1024-byte pool, implementing dynamic block splitting, instant adjacent block coalescing, real-time ASCII heap topology visualization, and single-pass fragmentation diagnostics.
architecture: Block Topology: Doubly linked list block header architecture enabling O(1) neighbor traversal for instant coalescing.
Fragmentation Reduction: Dynamic block splitting reduces internal waste on oversized matches; adjacent block coalescing recovers contiguous free space upon deallocation.
Strategy Engine: Comparative analysis across First Fit (fast traversal), Best Fit (exact sizing), and Worst Fit (stress testing).
Diagnostics: Single O(N) pass metrics engine calculating internal/external fragmentation percentages and largest contiguous block availability.
